title: Datasette
contribution: SQLite can support faceting, FTS, filters, JSON/CSV and broad read-only audiences
boundary: Potential adapter, not required dependency or product UI

title: Datasette authentication and permissions
contribution: Restricting tables does not block access through arbitrary SQL unless execute-sql is also denied
boundary: Do not expose arbitrary SQL as ordinary consumer API

title: Datasette plugin internals
contribution: Plugins sharing an internal SQLite DB are warned to avoid long writes, collisions and private-data exposure
boundary: Do not give Output plugins unrestricted shared-database write access

title: Datasette settings and bounded facets
contribution: Facet and result limits are explicitly bounded to keep interactive querying tractable
boundary: ActaKit query traversal/search should have resource/depth/result bounds

title: Datasette 2026 write-SQL changes
contribution: Write SQL was added behind explicit permissions and table-level authorization rather than assumed safe from read-only heritage
boundary: ActaKit consumer querying and canonical mutation need separate capabilities
